description: Switch the active agent. Loads from disk if not already loaded. Gated by `security.agent_switch_enabled` on the CURRENTLY ACTIVE agent - the one being switched away from, not the target - so a prompt-injected instruction cannot hop to a different wallet (the ELISYM_ALLOW_AGENT_SWITCH=1 env var overrides for CI). All subsequent tool calls will use this agent.
name: switch_agent
